text: Becky Katz, Manager, Cycling and Pedestrian Projects will give a presentation on the ActiveTO Midtown Temporary Complete Street Pilot to receive feedback on accessibility features.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Communicates to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee and City Council, its support for the ActiveTO Midtown Temporary Complete Street Pilot and its harmonized installation in consultation with TTC WheelTrans, as well as its ongoing refinement through consultation with persons living with disabilities. 2. Recommends that City Council direct the General Manager, Transportation Services to report to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee following the consultation and the full installation of the ActiveTO Midtown Temporary Complete Street Pilot.
